description: Israeli crypto brokerage Bits of Gold has disclosed a data breach that potentially exposed personal information belonging to around 200,000 customers. The company said a hacker accessed a third-party data analytics system containing names, national identification numbers, contact details, bank information, IP addresses and public wallet addresses. Bits of Gold said there is no indication that customer funds, private keys, passwords, CVV codes or scanned identity documents were compromised and urged users to remain alert to phishing attempts.
title: Israel’s Bits of Gold Suffers Data Breach Affecting 200,000 Customers

description: An alleged hands-on video of the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has leaked online, showing the design. It is shown in blue colour with rounded corners and a flat rear panel. It has a vertical camera island, and the camera module houses three sensors and has a similar design language to the standard Galaxy S26.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Leaked Hands-on Video Showcases Design

description: Anthropic has explained the technology behind Claude’s upcoming text watermarking system, which will use word-selection patterns to indicate whether the AI contributed to a passage. The company says the method will not alter response quality, add hidden characters or increase costs. Detection will be less reliable for short, factual or lightly edited text, while code will generally carry less of the watermark. Anthropic is also preparing a detection API and will apply C2PA metadata to supported files created or processed by Claude.
title: Claude Text Watermark Explained: How Anthropic Will Detect AI Content

description: Epic Games Store is officially coming to Linux soon. Epic Games has confirmed that its storefront will get a native Linux support. The company did not share a release timeline, but said it would not be part of the upcoming preview version. Epic Games Store is currently accessible on Linux via community-developed solutions like Heroic Games Launcher.
title: Epic Games Store Confirmed to Get Official Linux Support Soon

description: Samsung will launch five foldable smartphones next year, according to a report citing industry sources. The lineup is said to include the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9, Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra, Galaxy Z Flip 9, Galaxy Z TriFold 2, and a new Galaxy Z Fold 9 series wide-folding model. The company reportedly shared the information about the new wide-folding phone with its partners. Samsung’s third book-style foldable or second wide-folding handset will reportedly be equipped with a display better optimised for watching videos. This suggests that the next-generation lineup will include two wide-folding models, one conventional book-style foldable, one clamshell-style foldable, and the new twice-folding phone.
title: Samsung Plans to Launch Five Foldable Phones Next Year, Including Galaxy Z TriFold 2, Galaxy Fold 9 Series: Report

description: Jio has announced the re-introduction of the Jio Prime membership in India. Customers can get the Jio Prime membership with a one-time payment of Rs. 300. The Prime membership is available to all existing prepaid and postpaid Jio customers. However, users who are currently customers of a different telecom service provider can port to Jio to become a Jio Prime member, the company said. Among many benefits, the Jio Prime membership offers price certainty, cashback, and other exclusive benefits.
title: Jio Prime Membership Relaunched in India: Tariff Certainty, Cashback Vouchers, and More Benefits

description: Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo are confirmed to come with a 6,000mAh battery. The Ace 5G supports 18W fast charging via a USB Type-C port, with an 18W charger included in the box. The Boltt Ace 5G will have a 6.79-inch HD+ display, while the Evo will come with a 6.78-inch HD+ display. Both phones have a hole-punch cutout for the front cameras on the display.
title: Boltt Ace 5G, Evo 4G Battery, Display Details Teased Just Days Ahead of Launch

description: Google's Pixel 11 advertising campaign appears to feature a previously unseen fitness tracker with a small display. The wearable has similarities to Fitbit's Charge range and the Fitbit Air, but its screen sets it apart from the latter. Its repeated appearance in two adverts has raised questions about whether Google could be preparing another Fitbit device. The company has not identified the tracker or confirmed its development. It could also be an advertising element or AI-generated asset rather than a forthcoming retail product.
title: Google Pixel 11 Ads Reportedly Reveal Mysterious Fitbit-Like Fitness Tracker

description: BitMart users and employees are seeking answers about the crypto exchange’s assets, liabilities and ability to process withdrawals ahead of an August 19 deadline. An open statement addressed to BitMart executives calls for verifiable wallet and reserve information, third-party checks and a repayment plan for customers. The demands come weeks after BitMart announced plans to end trading on August 26 and wind down its operations by January 31, 2027.
title: BitMart Users Demand Answers Over Withdrawal Issues, Unpaid Salaries Ahead of August 19 Deadline

description: Ira Duo Pro 5G is the latest addition to Wishtel’s 2-in-1 PC lineup. The tablet currently retails in India on Amazon for just under Rs. 45,000. The Ira Duo Pro 5G ships with a folio case with an integrated keyboard that has most of the important keys. The 2-in-1 PC has a metal back, with part of the panel made of plastic. While the Ira Duo Pro 5G is quite thin and light, the folio case makes it feel heavy and bulky compared with some laptops in this price range.
title: Ira Duo Pro 5G First Impressions

description: OnePlus is said to have carried another round of price hikes for several smartphones under its portfolio in India. In recent months, the brand, along with other OEMs, has raised prices of multiple models, owing to a sharp increase in the price of memory components. According to a tipster, OnePlus’ recent price hike affects several smartphones, including the OnePlus Nord 6, Nord CE 6, Nord CE 6 Lite, OnePlus N6, and the recently launched OnePlus N6x.
title: OnePlus Nord 6, Nord CE 6, OnePlus N6, and More Price in India Hiked: Check Updated Prices

description: Samsung patent document on the World Intellectual Property Organisation (WIPO) website suggests that the company is considering a major design change for the Galaxy S27 series. The upcoming phones could feature a horizontal rear camera module. The module appears to sit almost flush with the rear panel. The Galaxy S27 Ultra is rumoured to come with a 6.9-inch display and a 5,700mAh battery. The Galaxy S27 Pro, on the other hand, is tipped to feature a 6.5-inch display and a 5,200mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Tipped to Feature Horizontal Rear Camera Module; Design and Key Specs Leaked Online

description: The iQOO 16 could feature a triple rear camera system with three 50-megapixel sensors, based on a new leak. The reported setup includes a 1/1.3-inch main sensor, a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera and a 50-megapixel periscope unit. Earlier leaks also suggest a 6.85-inch 2K 165Hz display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro processor and 8,500mAh battery. The phone may support 100W charging, wireless charging and IP68 and IP69 protection. Its China launch is expected later this year.
title: iQOO 16 Could Get Triple 50-Megapixel Cameras With Periscope Telephoto, Leak Suggests

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will be launched first, while the standard Xiaomi 18 will debut later, according to a tipster. If this is true, then the smartphone could be changing its launch schedule for its next-generation handsets. For reference, the Xiaomi 17 was launched in China last year on the same day as the Xiaomi 17 Pro and Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. This is similar to Apple’s rumoured launch schedule for this, where the tech giant is expected to first launch the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in September, and unveil the standard iPhone 18 early next year.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max Could Debut First, Standard Model Tipped for December

description: Call of Duty maker Activision could help develop future Halo games, according to a new report. The studio reportedly pitched an early prototype for Halo a game to Microsoft in June. The Xbox parent is said to have cancelled the prototype, but is exploring outsourcing development on future Halo projects.
title: Call of Duty Maker Activision Could Reportedly Help Develop Future Halo Games

description: SafePal has disclosed a data leak that potentially exposed the personal and purchase information of nearly 40,000 customers. The vulnerability in an order-tracking plugin affected orders placed between March 2025 and April 2026 and could have allowed unauthorised access to other customers’ order details. SafePal said there is no evidence that wallet access or customer funds were compromised. The company has fixed the flaw, added access controls and begun notifying affected users individually.
title: SafePal Data Breach Exposes Order Information of Nearly 40,000 Customers

description: The Boat PartyPal range brings eight new party speakers to the Indian market, with the lineup spanning different audio outputs, designs and feature sets. The PartyPal 650 leads the series with 300W RMS output, while the PartyPal 600 Plus and PartyPal 500 deliver 220W and 200W, respectively. Several models support Bluetooth 5.3, TWS, microphone and guitar inputs, while selected speakers add karaoke tuning, RGB lighting, recording and FM radio. Prices start at Rs. 9,499 for the PartyPal 230.
title: Boat PartyPal Speakers Launched in India With Karaoke ProTuner, RGB Lighting: Price, Features

description: Poco and Oppo have raised the prices of their old smartphones in India. The Poco X8 Pro is now listed on the e-commerce website at a starting price of Rs. 39,999 for the base 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration, which is notably higher than its launch price of Rs. 32,999. Meanwhile, the higher-end 12GB + 256GB model is now priced at Rs. 42,999, up from its launch price of Rs. 35,999. On the other hand, the Poco X8 Pro Max is currently available in India at a starting price of Rs. 48,999. The Oppo K13 Turbo Pro is now listed at a higher starting price of Rs. 41,999 for the base 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage model.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series, Oppo K13 Turbo Pro Get Price Hikes in India Across Variants: Check New Prices

description: The Redmi Note 17 series is all set to be launched in the global markets soon, the company announced on Monday. The handsets from the Xiaomi sub-brand made their China debut in July, while the brand also introduced the Redmi Note 17 in 5G and 4G variants globally. The global lineup is expected to comprise three models — Redmi Note 17, Note 17 Pro, and a new Note 17 Pro Max, with several specifications of the latter also revealed.
title: Redmi Note 17 Series Global Launch Date Announced, Company Reveals Key Specifications

description: OnePlus said to have worked with BOE to customise the new X4 light-emitting material for the OnePlus 16. This new material is said to offer improved power efficiency compared to the X3 material used in the OnePlus 15. The new display material could double the lifespan compared to the previous generation. The X4 display could outperform Samsung's M-series luminescent material.
title: OnePlus 16 Could Offer Major Display Upgrade With BOE X4 Material and Slim Bezels

description: Mozilla has introduced an experimental ad-blocking feature for Firefox on iOS that filters advertising content at the network level. The feature uses an EasyList-based filter to block several types of ads, trackers, pop-ups and overlays, while leaving search-result advertising and Firefox-sponsored content untouched. Users can activate or disable the blocker through Settings or the Site menu. Mozilla is releasing the feature through a progressive rollout, so availability remains limited for now. The company has not confirmed when it will reach all Firefox for iOS users.
title: Firefox for iOS Gets Native Ad Blocking for Ads, Trackers and Pop-Ups

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has been spotted on the list of supported devices on the Google Play Console. The Wi-Fi-only version has been listed with the model number SM-X940, while the two Wi-Fi + cellular models have been listed with the model numbers SM-X946B and SM-X946N. The listing seemingly confirms that the new tablet lineup from the South Korean tech giant will be launched in select global markets soon. Moreover, it suggests that the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra will be offered in two variants, with the cellular version supporting 5G connectivity. However, it is worth noting that the company has yet to confirm the launch of its new tablet lineup.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Spotted on Google Play Console Ahead of Expected Launch

description: European pricing, design and specifications of the Poco F9 Ultra and Poco F9 Pro have leaked online. The Poco F9 Pro is expected to be a rebranded version of the Chinese Redmi K100 Pro, while the Poco F9 Ultra is likely to be based on the Redmi K100 Pro Max. The Poco F9 Pro is tipped to feature a 6,330mAh battery, while the Poco F9 Ultra is said to feature an 8,050mAh battery. They could run on Snapdragon chipsets and include triple rear camera units.
title: Poco F9 Pro, Poco F9 Ultra European Prices and Specifications Leaked Online Ahead of Launch

description: Pova 8 Pro 5G full specifications list, colour options, and availability details have been confirmed a day before the phone's launch in India. The new dedicated microsite confirms that the upcoming Pova 8 Pro 5G will be available for purchase in India via Flipkart in Arc White, Graphite Black, and Tundra Green colour options. The tech firm claims that the phone will ship with an IP69K rating for dust and water resistance. On top of this, the Pova 8 Pro 5G is now confirmed to be equipped with a 50-megapixel primary camera on the back, with a Sony LYT-700C sensor and optical image stabilisation, paired with an 8-megapixel ultrawide camera.
title: Pova 8 Pro 5G Full Specifications List, Colour Options Revealed Ahead of India Launch

description: Poco M8x 5G will be launched in India later this month, the company announced on Monday. The upcoming handset will arrive as another addition to the Poco M8 series, which already comprises the M8 5G and the M8 Power 5G. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the Xiaomi sub-brand has also teased some of its features. The Poco M8x 5G is touted to be the first smartphone in India to be powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset.
title: Poco M8x 5G India Launch Date Announced; to Feature Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chipset

description: Kingdom Hearts IV will be released in late 2027, Square Enix has confirmed. The developer announced the release window at Disney's D23 fan event. Square Enix and Disney also announced they were working on an original anime series based on Kingdom Hearts.
title: Kingdom Hearts IV Will Launch in Late 2027, Square Enix Confirms

description: Vivo Y31T's specifications leaked ahead of official launch. It is said to come with a 6.75-inch LCD panel with HD+ resolution. It is likely to be offered in 4GB + 128GB, 6GB + 128GB, and 6GB + 256GB RAM and storage options. It is said to be available in Crimson Red, Gold Mist, and Seashore Green colours. It could run on a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset and a 7,200mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging.
title: Vivo Y31T Specifications, Design Leak Ahead of Launch, Tipped to Feature 7,200mAh Battery

description: The iQOO Neo 11 Ultra is set to arrive in China with a 50-megapixel Sony main camera and upgraded Live Photo tools. Sample images shared by the company show portrait, daylight and low-light results, while the camera system also brings stabilisation and new processing features. A recent leak has suggested further hardware details, including a 6.83-inch 2K 144Hz display, Dimensity 9500M chipset, 9,100mAh battery, 100W charging and an 8-megapixel ultrawide camera. iQOO has confirmed some display and chipset details.
title: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra Camera Samples Reveal 50-Megapixel Sony Sensor; Leak Suggests 9,100mAh Battery

description: Bitcoin slipped below $63,000 as renewed Middle East tensions weighed on risk appetite and US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded nearly $385 million in outflows between August 10 and 14. Investors are now awaiting the Federal Reserve minutes for clues on future monetary policy.
title: Bitcoin Falls Below $63,000 as Middle East Tensions Weigh on Crypto

description: Xiaomi is expected to launch its flagship smartphone lineup, widely known as the Xiaomi 18 series, later this year. According to a tipster, the company could make a significant change to its flagship smartphone strategy. Traditionally, Xiaomi’s numbered lineup has included an Ultra model. However, the Xiaomi 18 Ultra is reported to have been scrapped. Separately, other companies including Oppo and Vivo could skip global launches of their next-generation Ultra flagships, too.
title: Xiaomi 18 Ultra Launch Reportedly Scrapped With 'Pro Max' Becoming Top Flagship; Oppo, Vivo to Follow Suit

description: Vivo has raised the prices of multiple Y series models in India. The Vivo Y51 Pro 5G is now listed on the company website at a starting price of Rs. 32,999 for the base 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration, while the higher-end 8GB + 256GB model now retails at Rs. 37,999. Both models were earlier available for purchase at Rs. 30,999 and Rs. 33,999, respectively. Similarly, the Vivo Y31 5G is now listed on Vivo India online at Rs. 27,999 and Rs. 31,999 for the 6GB + 128GB and 6GB + 256GB variants. The prices of both models have been hiked from Rs. 25,999 and Rs. 28,999, respectively.
title: Vivo Y51 Pro 5G, Vivo Y31 and More Y Series Phones Receive Price Hikes in India: Check New Prices

description: Vivo Y31T 5G has been listed on the Vivo online store, confirming that the handset will be launched in India soon. The smartphone will be offered in Crimson Red, Golden Mist, and Seashore colour options. On top of this, the Vivo Y31T 5G will be available for purchase in the country in 4GB + 128GB, 6GB + 128GB, and 6GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. However, the company has yet to confirm the exact launch date of the phone. The Vivo Y31T 5G will launch in India as the company’s new dual-SIM phone that runs on Vivo’s Android 16-based OriginOS 6. It will sport a 6.75-inch HD+ (720 x 1,608 pixels) LCD touchscreen, with up to 120Hz refresh rate and up to 1,250 nits peak brightness.
title: Vivo Y31T 5G India Launch Confirmed; Full Specifications List, Design, and More Listed Online

description: Krafton India announced on Sunday that Battlegrounds Mobile India Lite (BGMI Lite) will launch in India by the end of 2026. The upcoming title is expected to arrive as a new way for players nationwide to engage with the massively popular online multiplayer battle royale game. While Krafton has not yet revealed its gameplay features or complete details, it says more information will be shared closer to launch.
title: Krafton Announces BGMI Lite for India, Set to Launch by the End of 2026

description: The Poco M8x 5G is confirmed to launch in India soon. It is expected to arrive as the latest addition to the M8-series lineup, which already comprises the Poco M8 and recently launched Poco M8 Power. While the company has teased its design, a launch date has yet to be announced. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a tipster has leaked the purported price and key hardware details of the upcoming handset.
title: Poco M8x 5G Could Launch in India Under Rs. 20,000, Key Specifications Tipped
